name: Backend API & Web Layer
description: Spring Boot REST controllers, security config/filters, scheduled jobs, AI integration entry points, and exception handling for the Java backend.

name: Backend Service Layer
description: Business logic services and entity/DTO mappers that orchestrate the Java backend's domain operations.

name: Backend Domain & Persistence Layer
description: JPA entities/domain model, Spring Data repositories, static reference data/resources, and backend unit/integration tests.

name: Backend Configuration & Infrastructure
description: Spring Boot application configuration classes, Maven wrapper, Dockerfile/Compose, backend-specific CI, and backend module docs.

name: Frontend UI Layer
description: React pages, feature modules, reusable components, routing, hooks, context, and styling for the InteliPath web client.

name: Frontend API Clients & Shared Utilities
description: Frontend API client wrappers, shared library helpers, utility functions, and TypeScript type definitions.

name: AI Agent Design References
description: Hallmark design-reference documentation and skill assets under .agents/skills used by AI coding agents, not application runtime code.

name: Python FastAPI Service Layer
description: FastAPI routes, scraping, RAG/LLM services, database access, Pydantic schemas, and tests for the intelipath-service microservice.

name: Project Documentation & Repository Root
description: Top-level project docs, demo static pages, profile README, repo-wide CI workflow, and analysis tooling artifacts.
